subject: Ad-hoc log retention authorization for live debugging — Finovate
messages:
From: Sam Green <sam.green@finovate.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Finovate SRE <sre@finovate.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Short-term log retention to debug live inference regressions

Hi Ava,

We've hit a reproducible inference regression in production around 2026-09-13 21:00 UTC that we need Redwood's help debugging. Our SREs believe retaining a slice of request/response traces and KV cache snapshots for ~72 hours will let both teams root-cause the issue without a full incident replay.

Can Redwood authorize a short-term exception to the standard deletion window for logs associated with account finovate-prod-1? If possible we'd include a minimal set: request IDs, prompts, model variant, timestamps, and the compact KV keys. Attached is a short manifest of traces we can provide (finovate_debug_manifest.txt).

We understand the sensitivity — we'll limit access to two Finovate engineers and one Redwood engineer. Please advise next steps and any forms you need.

Thanks,
Sam Green
Sr. Platform Engineer — Finovate
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@finovate.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term log retention to debug live inference regressions

Thanks Sam — filing this now.

Quick notes for process: we need an internal exception approval that documents timeframe, scope, and access controls. I've attached our internal temp-hold request form (temp_hold_form.docx) to capture:
- specific trace IDs or time ranges
- retention window (requested: 72 hours)
- who gets access (names/emails)
- storage location and encryption requirements

Looping in Dev for technical detail and Tessa for compliance/recording.

Next steps: Dev, can you confirm whether the requested artifacts can be isolated to a short-lived S3 path with KMS encryption and restricted IAM? Tessa, I'll need a quick sign-off cadence so Finovate can proceed.

Ava Chen
Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Sam Green <sam.green@finovate.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term log retention to debug live inference regressions

On Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 4:48 PM Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Looping in Dev for technical detail and Tessa for compliance/recording.

Sam — technical ack. We can stage the requested artifacts into a timeboxed S3 bucket under s3://redwood-temp-holds/finovate-prod-1/INF-4532/ with the following safeguards:
- KMS-encrypted bucket with a customer-shared key; auto-rotate disabled for the 72-hour window
- ACLs limited to a small RBAC group (redwood/dev_infra, finovate/sre-team) and no public access
- Object lifecycle rule to delete all objects at 72 hours + 2 hours grace; we will also run a confirmation job once deletion completes
- Audit log entries written to the compliance log stream and a Jira ticket link created for the hold (INF-4532)

I'll prepare the staging path and coordinate the export. NOTE: We cannot include full model weights or raw KV cache dumps that contain secrets; we'll only export metadata and compact key identifiers. Please confirm the precise trace IDs you need preserved.

—Dev
Senior SWE, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Sam Green <sam.green@finovate.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term log retention to debug live inference regressions

Thanks all — this is a classic short-lived debug exception. Per policy we need a formal approval from Compliance/InfoSec and a written attestation from the customer confirming the limited access list and accepted retention window.

Laura — can you review and, if acceptable, sign-off with the following mandatory controls:
- Timebox exactly 72 hours from the staging completion time; no manual extensions without approval
- KMS key usage with access audit; KMS key to be customer-rotated post-deletion if they request
- RBAC restricted to the named engineers only
- Audit log snapshot and deletion confirmation to be shared with Finovate and retained in our compliance archive for 1 year per policy

Sam — can you reply to confirm the two Finovate engineers who need access (full names + emails) and confirm you accept the controls above?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Trust & Safety — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Sam Green <sam.green@finovate.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term log retention to debug live inference regressions

On Wed, Sep 15, 2026 at 9:22 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Laura — can you review and, if acceptable, sign-off with the following mandatory controls:

I reviewed the request and approve the exception under the following conditions — please mirror these back in writing before we create the hold:
1) Exact scope: only the trace IDs listed in finovate_debug_manifest.txt and any immediate parent request metadata. No model parameter dumps, secret material, or PII beyond what is essential for debugging (mask user identifiers).
2) Timebox: 72 hours from the timestamp when Dev confirms the staging path is populated. Deletion job must run automatically; manual retention changes require my direct email approval and a ticket.
3) Access controls: we will require short-lived credentials (IAM role assumption) for Finovate engineers; no permanent cross-account keys. Redwood to provide a pre-signed audit snapshot when deletion completes.
4) Recordkeeping: attach approval_record_signed.pdf to the Jira ticket and retain the request metadata in our compliance store for 12 months.

Once Sam confirms the named engineers and accepts the constraints, I will sign and attach the approval_record_signed.pdf and mark INF-4532 as compliant.

Laura Bennett
Director, Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: Sam Green <sam.green@finovate.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Short-term log retention to debug live inference regressions

Laura/Tessa/Ava/Dev — confirmed. Finovate engineers: Lina Park <lina.park@finovate.com> and Mateo Ruiz <mateo.ruiz@finovate.com>. We accept the controls and scope as listed. Mask any end-user PII as requested.

Please proceed with staging and let me know when the hold is active; we'll coordinate debugging access window.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Sam
